title: The Truth About Happiness
subtitle: A Practical Guide to Living Joyfully
author: Rebecca L. Norrington
description: In this transformative guide, Rebecca draws on decades of personal experience and professional practice to reveal what happiness truly is — and how to cultivate it as a daily skill. Whether you're navigating grief, relationship challenges, or simply the quiet unhappiness of a life that looks good from the outside, this book offers practical tools rooted in personal responsibility and spiritual awareness.
